author: Myv
body:
Well, at 2:43pm it became 2 years since I first joined Avicus. I remember it to this day, and have seen Avicus change,
some for the worse, some for the better. Whatever, it's been a really good journey, and I guess I'm a semi-veteran now.

Anyway, AMA! Seems everyone does this at milestones. Here's to another year!

Ask Me Anything
